newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia approves $37.6 mln budget deficit for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia approves $37.6 mln budget deficit for 1997.

text.p: Mongolia's parliament has approved a 1997 state budget proposing a deficit of 26.3 billion tugriks ($37.6 million), official newspapers said on Saturday.
The budget for the next calendar year calls for revenues of 157.8 billion tugriks and spending of 184.1 billion tugriks, according to the official newspaper, Government News.

Revenues include 110 billion tugriks in taxes, 20 billion in capital income, seven billion in foreign aid and 20.8 billion in other income. Spending included 16.4 billion tugriks for banking reform and 1.5 billion tugriks for training students abroad. ($1 = 700 tugriks)
